item.title: SUMO Developer Meetings 2025
item.description:
2025-12-04

Attendees

  • Angelo Banse (DLR)
  • Pablo Alvarez Lopez (DLR)
  • Michael Behrisch (DLR)
  • Jakob Erdmann (DLR)
  • Yun-Pang Flötteröd (DLR)
  • Robert Hilbrich (DLR)
  • Ronald Nippold (DLR)
  • Peter Wagner (DLR)

Topics

  • Meeting on the 18th
    • will take place
  • visualizing TAZ labels
    • how to visualize sets of edges with a common label?
  • visualization discussions with Billy Charlton
    • Angelo takes over
  • global building model
    • https://tubvsig-so2sat-vm1.srv.mwn.de
    • https://github.com/zhu-xlab/GlobalBuildingAtlas
  • netedit interface
    • save all when saving neteditcfg?
    • no one uses neteditcfg ;-)

2025-11-20

Attendees

  • Angelo Banse (DLR)
  • Pablo Alvarez Lopez (DLR)
  • Michael Behrisch (DLR)
  • Jakob Erdmann (DLR)
  • Yun-Pang Flötteröd (DLR)

Topics

  • new Fox-Toolkit version
  • new Visual Studio version with prominent Co-Pilot
  • API-Key available for academic cloud
    • GPT-OSS available
  • setup for the mac
    • GUI tests
  • Release feedback
    • small regression with invalid error message in duarouter
    • netedit problem with additional files
  • check whether we can check at least compilation success before a commit is accepted -> Micha
    • minimal effort
  • Issues

2025-10-23

Attendees

  • Angelo Banse (DLR)
  • Pablo Alvarez Lopez (DLR)
  • Michael Behrisch (DLR)
  • Yun-Pang Flötteröd (DLR)
  • Ronald Nippold (DLR)

Topics

  • protocol still needs to be linked from the main site (Angelo)
  • Zoom meeting needs co-hosts (Micha)
  • offline docs currently require network link
  • openlayers should be substituted locally
  • Font size on Gnome? Anton Gladky did a patch for the debian package, Ronald had the opposite experience (fonts too large by default)
  • Packaging strange dependencies in Fedora RPM
    • Packaging might be abandoned we rather recommend pip or flatpak
  • Release moved to 6.11.
    • open issues to be discussed earlier because Jakob / Angelo are in a meeting on the 6th

2025-10-09

Attendees

  • Pablo Alvarez Lopez (DLR)
  • Michael Behrisch (DLR)
  • Yun-Pang Flötteröd (DLR)
  • Robert Hilbrich (DLR)
  • Ronald Nippold (DLR)
  • Peter Wagner (DLR)

Topics

  • running protocol instead of separate files
    • link is missing
  • Meso - Parallelization as technology transfer idea
  • SUMO conference offer has been improved

Issues

  • MacOS build needs doc for Parquet

2025-09-23

Attendees

  • Pablo Alvarez Lopez (DLR)
  • Michael Behrisch (DLR)
  • Jakob Erdmann (DLR)
  • Ronald Nippold (DLR)
  • Peter Wagner (DLR)

Topics

  • Release 1.25 moved to 27th of October (holidays)
  • we have 102 different labels which might not all be useful
    • we review them on demand
  • max-num-vehicles / max-num-persons
    • SUMO user wanted to use this type specific, we do not see the need

Issues

  • SUMO has now routing types to define vehicle type / class specific preferences for certain edges
    • https://sumo.dlr.de/docs/Simulation/Routing.html#routing_by_travel_time_and_routingtype
    • netedit support is open
  • automated routing can now be avoided if the improvement is below a threshold
    • routing performnace might also benefit -> Micha opens an issue
  • we have now parsable metadata

2026-07-16

Attendees

  • Pablo Alvarez Lopez (DLR)
  • Michael Behrisch (DLR)
  • Jakob Erdmann (DLR)
  • Ronald Nippold (DLR)

Topics

  • Lift
    • first beta implementation
    • gaps are not discrete but use vehicle / segment length
    • tau_ff is default headway
    • insertion checks on jammed segments changed
  • Meso
    • vehicles on internal lanes
    • maybe ignore simple splits
  • JuPedSim
    • Behavior is now identical but the new model is slower
  • RIS (Roadwork Impact Simulator)
    • 3D model is running
  • Visualization tools
    • kepler.gl
    • maplibre
    • deck.gl / pydeck
  • Issues

2026-06-18

Attendees

  • Pablo Alvarez Lopez (DLR)
  • Sasan Amini (transcality)
  • Angelo Banse (DLR)
  • Michael Behrisch (DLR)
  • Jakob Erdmann (DLR)
  • Yun-Pang Flötteröd (DLR)
  • Vassileios Karagounis (CERTH)

Topics

  • Platform dependent results
    • different number of router calls on Linux (Tests are failing)
  • Future of SUMOLibraries
    • Problems: size and maintenance effort
    • zlib.dll was renamed to z.dll (upstream change)
    • Switch to conan.io?
      • fox missing otherwise quite complete
      • versions can be explicitly selected
      • Pablo will have a look
    • downloadable zip only?
    • switch to gitlab
  • Changes in the JuPedSim coupling
    • two processes again (GRPC is coming back)
    • command line start should get another option
  • GUI next steps
    • SDL proto by Pablo by the end of July
    • look for API improvements which are useful for several possible GUIs
    • look again at it in September
  • supported OS / cmake / compiler versions
    • all OS which are still on LTS should build out of the box (Debian >= 11, ubuntu >= 22.04)
    • minimum cmake and minimum gcc / clang derived from that
    • update VisualStudio on build servers?
      • developers use 2022 or newer
  • Release 1.27.1
    • next week
  • Issues

2026-05-21

Attendees

Topics

    • libsumo macOS wheels broken
    • Jupedsim is on 1.4.1 only on Linux/macOS, Windows is still 1.3.1
  • Visual Studio 2026 works with SUMO
  • Requirements for a GUI
    • < 1.5 run time over plain sumo
    • at least 10fps in large scenarios
    • at least 10 data updates per second in large scenarios
    • Berlin should still be feasible in size
    • right clicks in Web GUI
    • have a look at https://github.com/behrisch/sumo-webgui
  • Issues

Attendees

Topics

    • Useragent ahs been fixed by Jakob
  • OpenGL/XQuartz issue still bother people
    • fox does not run natively on wayland and wayland does not run on macOS
    • some effort for native macOS GUI
      • it is on GitHub https://github.com/christofilojohn/sumoMacGUI
  • Latest Arrow requires C++20 whereas we use C++17
    • pin older arrow -> Docs needed -> Micha
  • pdoc
    • replaces old pydoc, looks much better structured
    • domain and connection are still missing
  • Badges
    • rather reduce number of tests behind the badges but add some GUI tests
  • Release
